Adds 27 new vanilla items as decoration for the Fish Tanks.
Items that can now be added to the tanks:[/size][/font][size=3]
[list]
[*][size=3]Dried Starfish[/size]
[*][size=3]Green Algae[/size]
[*][size=3]White Algae[/size]﻿
[*][size=3]Golden Coconut[/size]
[*][size=3]Dragon Tooth[/size]
[*]﻿[size=3]Artifact Trove[/size]
[*]﻿﻿[size=3]Fire Quarz[/size]
[*][size=3]Diamond[/size]
[*][size=3]Prismatic Shard[/size]
[*][size=3]Prehistoric Skull[/size]
[*][size=3]Prehistoric Tibia[/size]
[*][size=3]Ocean Stone[/size]
[*][size=3]Ghost Crystals[/size]
[*][size=3]Dolomite[/size]
[*][size=3]Aerinite[/size]
[*][size=3]Alamite[/size]
[*][size=3]Geminite[/size]
[*][size=3]Nekoite﻿[/size]

[*][size=3][b]Iridium Ore[/b] turns into [b]Iridium Node[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]Cinder Shard[/b] turns into [b]Cinder Shard Node[/b][/size]

Additional Special items:[/size][list]

[/size][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy![/size]
[b]
[size=5]Additional Information[/size][/b]
[size=3]The decorations are added as [i]bottom creatures[/i] so they can be added multiple times to the same tank (if the tank is large enough), unlike the regular decorations (stone, seaweed & coral). They will take up space from other [i]bottom creatures[/i] unfortunately (Tip: By installing the mod ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11388]Increased Fish Tank Capacity[/url], unlimited fish and bottom creatures can be added to fish tanks). [/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]Like the other [i]bottom creatures[/i], the [i]new decorations[/i] change position every time you enter the farmhouse.[/size]

﻿[/font][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][font=Arial]
[size=3]The mod has only been tested on Android, but should also be compatible on PC (Windows, Linux and Mac).
Problems with other mods can only occur if the other mods edit the fish data (Data/AquariumFish; [b]Mod does not work with SVE![/b]). Otherwise, the mod should be compatible with all other mods.[/size][/font]
